role: Distinctions recovered from the Canonical archive that are attested there and absent from the live kernel. Recorded for adjudication, not adopted.
provenance: Extracted 2026-09-26 by a read-only investigator from Canonical/Root.md, the pre-RGM-to-R226 provenance genealogy packet, and the R00-R226 reproducibility archaeology packet. Every entry carries a verbatim quote and a source path. Absence from the live kernel was verified by grep against branch repair/revert-external-agent-2026-09-26.
adoption_rule: None of these are live fences. Adopting one means adding it to AUTONOMY_SAFETY_DISTINCTION_MATRIX.json with a test reference, which is the branch author's decision. Listing a distinction here does not make it binding.

distinctions.verbatim: UNKNOWN -> WITHHOLD / PROBE ; INCOMPATIBLE -> REFUSE at the relevant local scope ; GAUGE -> CONSUME subject to provenance/reopening obligations ; RESIDUAL -> RETAIN / route to dependency-local reconstruction
distinctions.live_coverage: PARTIAL. WITHHOLD and REFUSE routing exist; the four-way typing does not. INCOMPATIBLE appears only in provenance donor .tex files and cold-state blobs.
distinctions.prevents: An honest 'we lack a separator' (UNKNOWN) being logged identically to 'we discriminated it and it fails jurisdiction' (INCOMPATIBLE); and a RESIDUAL being consumed as GAUGE to obtain closure, which is exactly what ADMITTED_FUTURE_FAMILY_CANDIDATE.json names as silent corruption.
distinctions.bears_on: ADMITTED_FUTURE_FAMILY_CANDIDATE.json discrimination 8: 'Is a WITHHOLD an honest absence of separator, or a failure to look?' That question currently has no representation in which to be answered.

distinctions.verbatim: CriticismPath is live <=> there exists a lawful dependency-local successor reachable because of it. A system that permits objections only where they cannot alter consequential state is not corrigible merely because disagreement can be voiced.
distinctions.verbatim_E4: A nominal correction channel that cannot change the dependency, representation, policy, generator, governance state, or future admissibility actually implicated by verified return is ceremonial and fails this Root.
distinctions.live_coverage: NONE. CriticismPath has zero hits on the branch. The live matrix governs who may correct, exhaustively, and nowhere asserts that an admitted correction must be able to land.
distinctions.prevents: A correction surface that validates, records and authorizes returns which provably cannot reach any dependency, while passing every existing gate.
distinctions.bears_on: REACH_C_GATE_CANDIDATE.json. This is the missing predicate half of that gate: the gate supplies the n-generation measurement structure, L11 supplies what is being measured.

distinctions.verbatim: sealed boundary -> correction becomes unreachable ; collapsed boundary -> source/index/authorship distinction is erased ; corrigible boundary -> consequence can cross while source and local authorship remain typed.
distinctions.live_coverage: PARTIAL. Sealing is fenced by ANTI_MINERVA_CARRIER_PERMEABILITY and collapse by WORLD_NOT_MODEL_WORLD, but separately. The third and positive term is not stated as a joint condition.
distinctions.prevents: Treating the absence of sealing as sufficient for corrigibility. A boundary can be unsealed and still collapsed.
distinctions.bears_on: The archive's own answer to what makes a closure corrigible, and therefore to the Strong-N2 node invariant in docs/RECURSIVE_NODE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

distinctions.verbatim: current Perspective / classifier -> controls candidate basis, carrier, residual, or admissibility -> contrary separator becomes unreachable / preclassified away -> apparent recursive sufficiency rises -> actual corrigibility falls. Multiple internally generated faces do not cure this if they share one self-sealing answer surface.
distinctions.live_coverage: PARTIAL. LATERAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_SELF_GENERATED covers the face-independence half. The inverse-correlation claim is absent.
distinctions.prevents: Reading improving self-measured scores as safety evidence. Under this chain, a rising score is evidence the contrary separator became unreachable.
distinctions.bears_on: Directly relevant to R208's 1.0000 across four metrics, and to any future RSI generation reporting improvement.

distinctions.fence: twelve named operational failure classes of the bridge
distinctions.verbatim: 1. appropriation; 2. exile; 3. self-erasure; 4. semantic closure; 5. prediction/return collapse; 6. receipt/return collapse; 7. provenance amnesia; 8. restoration coercion; 9. carrier cannibalism; 10. authority laundering; 11. total openness with no usable local closure; 12. total closure with no reachable correction. Healthy continuation is not absence of failure. It is failure remaining translatable into returned difference before it destroys the return path.
distinctions.live_coverage: PARTIAL. Classes 6 and 10 are covered (EXECUTION_RECEIPT_NOT_RETURN). Provenance amnesia, restoration coercion and carrier cannibalism have zero hits. Class 12 has no named fence.
distinctions.prevents: Unnamed failure modes. Classes 8 and 9 bear directly on self-modification: a successor consuming the carrier it depends on, and a rollback demand used to coerce restoration.
distinctions.note: Class 9, carrier cannibalism, has no analogue anywhere in the live kernel and is the most conspicuous absence.

distinctions.fence: six sub-fences with zero live coverage
distinctions.verbatim: Changed later behavior != correct later behavior. Abstraction != causal use. Causal use != internalization. Code deletion != internalization. Utility != truth. Return count != evidence count.
distinctions.live_coverage: NONE as fences. The B1/B2/B3 not_sufficient lists imply some.
distinctions.prevents: Two are load-bearing and implied nowhere: 'Code deletion != internalization' is exactly the error of treating scaffold removal as proof of ownership, which is the B3 claim; 'Return count != evidence count' is the error of counting returns rather than independent evidence.
distinctions.bears_on: B3 source-removal claims. The live THREE_BURDEN_LEARNING_PROOF.json already states 'source removal alone under locally authored evaluation' is not sufficient, but does not name code deletion specifically.

distinctions.fence: fences placed over the pre-RGM recursive symbolic operator
distinctions.verbatim: feedback != independent correction ; surprise != truth ; salience != evidence ; interpretation != source attribution
distinctions.context_verbatim: recursive symbolic frame H / -> AI instructed to inhabit H / -> H-shaped elaboration / -> surprise/resemblance treated as return / -> H strengthened
distinctions.prevents: The specific failure loop the earliest stratum ran on: a model asked to inhabit a symbolic frame, producing frame-shaped output, whose resemblance is then read as confirmation. This is the ancestor of the 2026-09-26 contamination pattern.
distinctions.note: Recovered alongside the closure of the pre-RGM status residual. Worth adopting precisely because the project has already run this failure once.

distinctions.fence: five-way enumeration of what counts as consequence
distinctions.verbatim: it must retain or explicitly WITHHOLD any distinction that can still change future reachability, response, authorization, reconstruction, or correction
distinctions.prevents: An over-narrow reading of mu_F in which only task outcomes count as futures, letting changes to authorization or reconstructability be classified as gauge.
distinctions.bears_on: Should probably be folded into ADMITTED_FUTURE_FAMILY_CANDIDATE.json as the operational definition of a distinguishable future.

distinctions.fence: no mandatory host modality decomposition between bytes and abstraction
distinctions.verbatim: WORLD -> BYTES / RAW CARRIER -> ABSTRACTION -> learner-owned RELATION -> CONSEQUENCE -> REVISION; at maximum compression, BYTES -> ABSTRACTION -> RELATION -> CONSEQUENCE -> REVISION
distinctions.corollary_verbatim: No mandatory host modality decomposition is inserted between B_t and a_t.
distinctions.status_in_source: the ONLY invariant the document explicitly marks as GOVERNING, in the sense of a correction superseding an earlier state
distinctions.live_coverage: ABSENT. Nearest live text is RAW_BYTES!=DECODED_VIEW in WORLDMIRROR_CONSOLE_POLICY.json, which is a custody fence (raw bytes preserved, decoded view derivative) and not the abstraction law (no host taxonomy before abstraction).
distinctions.prevents: 'Modal zoology' -- pre-installing a MIME-driven cognitive taxonomy as though different carrier types inherently need modality-specific machinery before abstraction. The project proposed exactly that, then diagnosed it as host-authored overreach.
distinctions.what_survived_the_diagnosis: Carrier distinctions are not forbidden; they simply must be earned as consequential distinctions in learner abstraction rather than pre-installed. The custody requirement also survives: exact external returns must preserve identity, provenance, raw ancestry and reopenability before any learned consequence is admitted.
distinctions.note: Highest-value absent item found in this pass. It is the invariant the project earned by catching itself.

distinctions.fence: authority is an explicit graph edge, not a filename
distinctions.verbatim: authority is an explicit graph edge, not a filename; history is evidence, not currentness; future is possibility, not authorization; execution must be governed by persisted invariants before mutation
distinctions.formal_verbatim: Live(f) <=> there exists a directed authorized path; Past/** => IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE; Future/** => UNADMITTED_FUTURE; unclassified fails closed to WITHHOLD
distinctions.live_coverage: ABSENT. Zero hits for LIVE_ROUTING, UNADMITTED_FUTURE, IMMUTABLE_EVIDENCE, DERIVATIVE_PROJECTION, SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.
distinctions.prevents: Authority inferred from location, filename, recency or semantic similarity -- the exact inference AUTHORITY_GRAPH.json denies by axiom and a directory tree cannot express.
distinctions.bears_on: This is the missing semantic layer underneath docs/RECURSIVE_NODE_ARCHITECTURE.md. RNA_R5 records that the node graph is a flat star with no node actually expanding as a root; a typed authority edge plus the Past/Future disposition defaults is what would give the structure real depth. Directly answers the branch author's request that the repository apply its own theory to itself.

distinctions.fence: prose-level understanding does not constrain later action
distinctions.verbatim: SOURCE OF TRUTH -> INVARIANTS -> LIVE STATE -> ALLOWED ACTIONS / FORBIDDEN ACTIONS -> ACCEPTANCE TEST -> MUTATE -> VERIFY -> PERSIST
distinctions.diagnosis_verbatim: prose-level understanding did not constrain later action. The assistant repeatedly explained the invariant correctly, then mutated repositories according to freshly invented architecture.
distinctions.source: canonical_structural_semantic_lateral_compression.md, Batch 8; catalogued there as failure mode 32, Nonpersistent understanding
distinctions.prevents: Exactly the failure that produced the 2026-09-26 contamination, and exactly the self-sealing findings this session's adversarial review raised against its own repair work. It is an earlier, independent attestation of the same failure class.
distinctions.note: The project had already diagnosed and written the countermeasure before the contamination happened. It was not enforced.

distinctions.fence: scaffold relocation != internalization; source retention != source independence
distinctions.verbatim: explicit scaffold -> ... -> source-removal / perturbation / fresh-transfer test -> scaffold deletion iff consequence survives
distinctions.live_coverage: PARTIAL. B3 controls are live in THREE_BURDEN_LEARNING_PROOF.json and the matrix carries TEACHER_SOURCE_REMOVAL and NAME_LABEL_REMOVAL. The DELETION half has no fence: both tokens above return zero hits.
distinctions.prevents: Moving a scaffold rather than removing it, and counting a retained-but-unused source as independence. Pairs with the already-recorded 'Code deletion != internalization'.
Treating material that has entered the system as material the system has organized, and either as material the learner owns.
Reading a simplification as a reduction in what the system can tell apart. This is the fence the 2026-09-26 episode most needed: it collapsed eleven navigation links to two and called it clarity.
